# Spain Crop fields of Canary Islands

Spain Canary Islands field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Gobierno de Canarias - Consejería de Agricultura, Ganadería, Pesca y Soberanía Alimentaria. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cn/latest/es_cn.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cn/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:32628; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: crop:code, crop:name, collection, admin_island, id, metrics:area, geometry, determination:datetime, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cn/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cn/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_cn/collection.json
